artifact_method: Sealed independent strict DER parser plus direct RSA modular exponentiation using public res/keys; no signer import or private key read

negative_tests.name: P291 key instead of RK key

static_checks: RK1 photograph reached extractor findUSB and stopped before inventory/destination/capture; absence of accepted USB is not proof of absent hardware.

SD destination requires exact /mnt/external_sd root mount, vfat, both mount and superblock RW, physical mmc topology, card type SD, CID, exact delivered geometry, and matching read-only ioctl/stat/sysfs evidence.
Package must be regular /mnt/external_sd/update.zip on the same st_dev; later checks pin inode, size, marker, CID, topology and mount.
All inventoried eMMC sources are separated from SD major/minor and sysfs ancestry before creating output and during capture revalidation.
Internal block opens remain O_RDONLY. No mount, remount, unmount, format, raw writes, reboot or USB fallback was introduced.

capture.go and selection.go remain byte-identical to 0.1, retaining source stability checks, 1GiB parts, 128MiB reserve, exclusive destination creation, fsync, destination reread and full source reread.
SD available space is checked against all selected sources plus reserve; the software does not omit a selected source just to fit.
New Python reader accepts legacy inventories and checks optional SD proof, mount agreement and source separation without opening device/sysfs paths from reports.
PC preparer identifies both physical media, copies staged files before retiring exactly two hash-verified archived SD predecessors, and preserves Kingston; no reformat or raw write.

tests_scope.go_host_environment: Windows amd64; events include subtests and groups
tests_scope.reader_skip: real symlink creation unavailable to Windows test account; recorded separately

nonblocking_observations: Four-entry ZIP intentionally retains absent META-INF/com/android/metadata. On RK1 the warning did not prevent executable entry; RK2 physical acceptance remains pending.
The current plan is C only. DT matching and a plan reference do not prove the physical device equals a prior Android capture.
Package identity is pinned by ordinary file/device/inode/size, not repeatedly hashed at runtime. Recovery verifies the selected ZIP before entry; PC copy has its own hash verification.
Directory/file descriptors preserve destination confinement after mount loss; no universal hard deadline exists for a blocked kernel operation.
limitations: This is static and PC artifact validation, not observed SD/RW sysfs execution in the physical recovery.
Recovery can write its own cache/logs/metadata even though extractor opens internal blocks only for reading.
Busy/inaccessible regions and unsupported storage remain omitted. This is not an atomic snapshot, complete-device guarantee, malware attestation or tested restoration.
Rockchip development trust provides laboratory compatibility, not exclusive production update security.
No claims of volume flush, safe physical ejection or TV execution follow from this review.
